query:
SELECT m.id, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, s.companyName
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '9319401'
AND m.timeSlot = 9
AND s.companyName LIKE '%Symphony%';
